title: Holi in Dubai: What to Wear to Holi in the UAE (2027 Guide)
excerpt: What to wear to Holi in Dubai and the UAE: breathable cotton for the heat, modest cuts for public venues and easy looks for resort events.
body:
For Holi in Dubai or anywhere in the UAE, wear a breathable cotton kurta set or co-ord that covers your shoulders and knees, with a light dupatta, sunglasses and comfortable sandals or trainers. The days are warm, so choose airy cotton over heavy fabrics and keep the look modest for shared venues.

This guide is for women celebrating Holi in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah or elsewhere in the UAE in late March 2027 (check your local calendar). A [grey hand block print cotton kurta set with Kota Doria dupatta](/products/grey-hand-block-print-cotton-kurta-pant-kota-doria-dupatta-set/) is a smart, airy choice for the day.

*By the Bahe Kurtiz styling team, Jaipur. Our block prints are hand printed by karigars, and our pieces are made in our own Jaipur unit.*

## What should you wear to Holi in Dubai?

In the UAE, Holi tends to happen at organised events, hotels, clubs, community venues or private homes rather than on public streets. Each setting has its own dress code, so read the event page or ask your host first.

The safest all-round choice is a cotton kurta set with pants or palazzos. It covers you well, breathes in the heat and looks festive in photos. Short sleeves or elbow sleeves are fine for most events; for public or family venues, avoid very short hemlines, deep necklines and backless tops.

Light and mid-tone colours feel fresher under strong sun than black or navy, and they make gulal look brighter.

## How do you dress for the UAE heat on Holi?

Late March in the UAE is warm, and an outdoor event in the afternoon can feel properly hot. Fabric is everything. Hand block print cotton and Kota Doria are light, airy and easy to wash, while polyester and heavy silks feel sticky within minutes.

Keep layers to a minimum. A kurta and palazzo, or a co-ord, is enough on its own. Use your dupatta as a light cover for your head or shoulders when the sun is overhead, and add sunglasses and a hat if the event allows.

Indoors, many venues are strongly air-conditioned. If your celebration moves inside for lunch or music, carry a thin cotton shawl or a light shirt to throw on.

Footwear matters in the heat too. Sandals with a back strap or breathable trainers are easier than heels on grass or sand, and they survive coloured water better than leather. Keep a spare pair in the car if you are driving on to lunch.

> **From our Jaipur studio:** We make our block print pieces in Jaipur, where summers are hot and dry, so we know what feels good in heat. Loose cotton with a little ease at the chest and hip lets air move, and a Kota Doria dupatta weighs almost nothing. Pick a mid-tone print and colour splashes blend in instead of standing out.

|---|---|---|---|

| Hotel or resort Holi party | Printed co-ord set | Follow the venue's dress code | Sandals with grip |
| Private villa or backyard | Co-ord or tunic with pants | Your host's call | Old trainers |
| Temple or puja before play | Embroidered cotton kurta set | Modest, dupatta for the head | Easy slip-ons |

## What should you carry to a Holi event in the UAE?

Keep your bag small, as most events are busy and you will want your hands free.

- Sunglasses and a hat or cap
- A water bottle (many events have refill points, but check)
- Phone in a zip or waterproof pouch
- Wipes and a small towel
- A light shawl for air-conditioned indoor areas
- A clean top or kurta for the drive home

Respect the setting. Play only with those who are joining in, keep colour inside the event area, and follow the organiser's rules on music and colour.

## Which outfits work for a puja or lunch after Holi?

Many families start the day with a small puja and end it with a long lunch. For those moments, switch into something clean and slightly dressier. ## Frequently asked questions

**What should I wear to a Holi event in Dubai?**
A breathable cotton kurta set or co-ord that covers your shoulders and knees, with sunglasses and comfortable shoes. Check the event's dress code first.

**Can I wear shorts or a crop top to Holi in the UAE?**
For public and family events, it is better to stay modest. Private parties may be more relaxed, but follow your host's lead.

**Which fabric is best for Holi in the UAE heat?**
Light cotton, especially hand block print cotton, and airy weaves such as Kota Doria. Avoid polyester and heavy silks for outdoor play.
